newsitem.title: USA: Cone Mills names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Cone Mills names chief financial officer.

text.p: Cone Mills Corp on Tuesday said it named Anthony Furr as vice president and chief financial officer effective May 1.
Furr was previously chairman, president and chief executive of Wachovia Bank of South Carolina N.A. and an executive vice president of the bank's parent, Wachovia Corp.
Cone produces denim fabrics and prints home furnishing fabrics.

Cone Mills said its current financial chief John Bakane was named president of Cone Apparel Products Group. In his new position, Barkane will have senior executive responsibility for the company's foreign and domestic denim operations.
Bakane, who will remain an executive vice president of the company, is presently an executive vice president and chief financial officer and a member of the board of directors.
